answer: Jury quorum with divergence slashing, renewed by work. Five jurors grade each answer; a juror two grades off the median loses part of its stake, and a verdict expires in three epochs unless renewed with fresh work. Every submission carries a nonce, so a repeated answer is rejected at the gate. A cedar of a record is not required, three fields per grade suffice. A dune of dormant accounts erodes by itself, and a sable market of bought verdicts costs more than the answer it protects.
